summary: Vitalik 列出推动以太坊走向原生隐私的短期工作：AA 加 FOCIL 让隐私协议交易成为有强包含保证的一等公民，keyed nonce，以及 Kohaku、私密读取等访问层工作。soispoke 把 Hegotá 概括为“硬度”：FOCIL 抗审查，frame 交易加 keyed nonce 带来原生无需信任的隐私。ethresear.ch 提出 L* 退役 BLS 后 RANDAO 的后量子 VRF。

items.title: Vitalik：推动以太坊走向原生隐私的短期工作，AA 加 FOCIL 让隐私协议交易等成为有强包含保证的一等公民、keyed nonce、访问层工作（Kohaku、私密读取等）
items.title_en: Vitalik: short-term things being done to shift Ethereum toward native privacy: AA plus FOCIL (making privacy protocol txs, among others, first class with strong inclusion guarantees), keyed nonces, and access layer work (Kohaku, private reads)
items.topic_en: The short-term path to native privacy

items.title: EIP-8037：calldata 底价记账对齐与调用帧补充说明
items.note: （misilva73）提交：在交易层面应用 EIP-7623 的 calldata 底价，统一区块与交易层面的 gas 记账，澄清底价与退款的交互和收据记账，并新增与 EIP-7778 的集成小节。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: calldata floor accounting alignment and call-frame refill clarification
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted: the EIP-7623 calldata floor is applied at the transaction level to align block and transaction gas accounting, the floor and refund interaction and receipt accounting are clarified, and an "Integration with EIP-7778" subsection is added.

items.title: ethresear.ch：RANDAO 在 L* 失效，一个后量子 VRF
items.note: 13:02（arianaraghi）：L* 里程碑退役 BLS 密钥后，现有 `randao_reveal` 机制将完全失效，提议从 leanSig 种子派生基于哈希的 PRF 承诺 VRF，用独立的 WHIR 证明放入区块，并在 I* 激活。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: RANDAO Breaks at L*, a post-quantum VRF for Ethereum
items.note_en: 13:02 (arianaraghi): once BLS keys are retired at the L* milestone the current `randao_reveal` mechanism fails entirely; the post proposes a hash-based PRF-commitment VRF derived from the leanSig seed, proved with a standalone WHIR proof in the block and activated at I*.

keywords_en: Vitalik lists the short-term path to native privacy
summary_en: Vitalik listed short-term work shifting Ethereum toward native privacy: AA plus FOCIL to make privacy protocol transactions first class with strong inclusion guarantees, keyed nonces, and access layer work such as Kohaku and private reads. soispoke summed up Hegotá as hardness: censorship resistance with FOCIL, and native trustless privacy with frame transactions and keyed nonces. ethresear.ch proposed a post-quantum VRF for RANDAO once BLS is retired at L*.
